why: Kokoro's torch pipeline phonemizes Mandarin with misaki's ZHG2P and Japanese with misaki's Cutlet; misaki does not install on Python 3.13, so the ONNX backend carries this copy.
trim_policy: OTR's copy deletes upstream functions and constants that nothing in the pack calls; each deletion is named in that file's 'change'. upstream_sha256 is always misaki 0.9.4's own file and is never recomputed, so a trimmed file no longer equals upstream and only the rows whose change starts with 'none' are byte copies.

transcription.py.change: trimmed: the module-level INITIALS and FINALS (key views of INITIAL_MAPPING and FINAL_MAPPING that nothing reads) are removed and a two-line OTR note is added after the header; every other line is upstream's; its own MIT notice is at the top

zh.py.change: the version '1.1' frontend branch removed (it imports zh_frontend, not vendored); __init__ refuses any version but None; __call__ ends at the legacy return

num2kana.py.change: trimmed: ConvertKanji and do_kanji_convert (kanji to arabic number; cutlet.py imports only Convert) are removed and a two-line OTR note is added after the header; every other line is upstream's

data/__init__.py.change: a one-line docstring (upstream is empty; a 0-byte file reads as truncation here)

cutlet.py.change: mojimoji removed: han_to_zen after NFKC is a no-op and zen_to_han after NFKC is a three-character table (both measured over every code point); the fugashi Tagger pinned to unidic-lite; import os
